import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def model(p,t,P):
    return p[0] + p[1]*P + p[2]*P**2 + p[3]*np.log(P) + (p[4]*t*np.exp(-p[5]*t))/P + p[6]*t/P
def res(p): return model(p,t,P)-dP_dt
best=None
for b in [0.02,0.05,0.1,0.2]:
    p0=np.array([9,-4,0.4,2.9,0.5,b,0.0])
    r=least_squares(res,p0)
    v=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
    if best is None or v<best[0]: best=(v,r.x)
print(best[0]); print(np.round(best[1],4))
